title: Agent Protocol v1 schemas (packages/protocol)
description: Define agent lifecycle and transport schemas; submission-domain schemas are implemented separately in T7
acceptance: packages/protocol/src/agent.ts exports all schemas with schemaVersion
RunRequest: benchmark, benchmarkVersion, lane, caseId, objective, requiredOutputs, toolGateway, limits
RunResponse: agentRunId, status (accepted|running|awaiting_tool|completed|failed|cancelled)
RunStatus enum matches spec
Run lifecycle response supports an optional schema-validated completion payload wired in T7 without duplicating submission types
Protocol errors have stable machine-readable codes
Unit tests cover valid requests and rejected unknown versions/statuses
No circular dependencies

title: Tool Protocol v1 schemas (packages/protocol)
description: Define Zod schemas for all 12 v0.1 tools with input/output validation
acceptance: packages/protocol/src/tools.ts exports all tool schemas
case.*: list_documents, get_document_metadata, read_document, search_documents, get_structured_record, request_information
policy.*: search, get_rule
finance.*: calculate, calculate_ratios, validate_spread
submission.*: save_artifact
Each tool: input schema, output schema, error schema, callId for idempotency
Tool names exactly match spec: case.list_documents, case.read_document, etc.
Generated OpenAPI includes all tool endpoints

title: Event Log v1 + JCS hash chain (packages/protocol)
description: Define 15 event types with RFC 8785 canonicalization and hash chain
acceptance: packages/protocol/src/events.ts exports EventSchema with schemaVersion

15 event types: RUN_STARTED, AGENT_READY, AGENT_RUN_STARTED, TOOL_CALL, TOOL_RESULT, TOOL_ERROR, ARTIFACT_SAVED, LIMIT_WARNING, AGENT_COMPLETED, AGENT_FAILED, RUN_CANCELLED, RUN_COMPLETED, SCORING_STARTED, SCORE_COMPONENT_CREATED, SCORING_COMPLETED
Fields: eventId, runId, caseId, sequence, timestamp, source, type, payload, previousHash, hash
hash = SHA256(JCS canonical JSON excluding hash field, including previousHash)
Helper functions: computeHash(event), verifyChain(events[])
NDJSON writer/reader utilities
Unit tests for hash chain verification

title: UnderwritingSubmission + supporting schemas (packages/protocol)
description: Complete submission schemas: FinancialSpread, NormalizedFact, RiskFinding, Discrepancy, ComplianceFinding, FollowUpRequest, PolicyAssessment, Recommendation, CitedClaim, Decision, Money
acceptance: packages/protocol/src/submission.ts exports all schemas
FinancialSpread: canonical fields with currency, scale, period, sign convention
NormalizedFact: canonicalKey, value, normalizedValue, type, unit, currency, scale, period, origin, citations, confidence, conflictGroup
RiskFinding: riskId, category, severity, weight, requiredEvidence, acceptableConcepts, evidenceSupport
Discrepancy: type, description, sourceA, sourceB, variance, materiality, status
ComplianceFinding: subject, provider, matchScore, lists, categories, matchState, disposition
FollowUpRequest: requestId, concept, status, response, revealedDocuments
PolicyAssessment: applicableRules[], evaluations[]
Recommendation: decision, confidence, proposedAmount, proposedTermMonths, conditions[], policyExceptions[], rationale[]
CitedClaim: claim, evidenceIds[], confidence
Money: amount (integer minor units), currency (ISO 4217)
Decision enum includes INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION
Completed agent-run responses reference UnderwritingSubmissionSchema from this module without redefining it
review_notes: Transient NVIDIA capacity failure: ResourceExhausted worker request limit. No implementation patch was produced; resume after provider capacity recovers.

title: Schema generation pipeline (JSON Schema, OpenAPI, Markdown)
description: Generate language-neutral artifacts from Zod 4 schemas and make CI validate drift
acceptance: packages/protocol/scripts/generate.ts uses Zod 4 JSON Schema output as the canonical generated representation
OpenAPI 3.1 components wrap generated JSON Schemas without duplicate hand-authored schemas
Output directories: generated/json-schema/, generated/openapi/, generated/markdown/
pnpm generate runs without errors
CI step: generate → git diff --exit-code (fails if committed artifacts drift)
Markdown reference pages are written to docs/specification/generated/
Python Pydantic SDK generation is explicitly deferred until protocol v1 is frozen

title: Protocol conformance testkit + fake async agent
description: Build test suite that validates agent implements protocol correctly
acceptance: packages/testkit/src/conformance.ts tests: health/version, start/poll/complete/fail/cancel, unknown version, duplicate start idempotency, timeout, malformed JSON, oversized output, invalid final schema, tool call after completion, agent restart during run
packages/testkit/src/fake-agent.ts implements all 4 endpoints with configurable behavior
examples/deterministic-baseline exposes the fake agent as a runnable HTTP process for local vertical-slice tests
Fake agent passes all conformance tests
Test output shows which checks pass/fail with clear messages

title: Case Schema v1 + validator + packer (packages/case-schema)
description: Define case.yaml schema, case directory validator, .uwb packer with input/reference split
acceptance: packages/case-schema/src/case.ts: CaseSchema with schema_version, case_id, track, benchmark_version, jurisdiction, as_of_date, currency, requested_product, requested_amount, supported_lanes, features, budgets

packages/case-schema/src/validator.ts: validates directory structure, required files, no traversal paths, no symlinks, all logical IDs unique, citations within document bounds, policy rules have deterministic test form, PII has legal-use classification

packages/case-schema/src/packer.ts: creates input.uwb with normalized/ only for normalized_data and reasoning_only lanes, never raw_documents; reference.uwb contains private/ expected outputs and scorer config
The package exports a validateCase API for the CLI task to consume
Packaging round-trip: pack → unpack → validate passes

title: Filesystem local runner (packages/runner)
description: Trusted runner with budget enforcement, cancellation, event hash chain, result directories
acceptance: packages/runner/src/local-runner.ts: LocalRunner class with run(casePath, agentUrl, options)
Enforces: wallClockSeconds, maxToolCalls, maxOutputBytes, maxConcurrentToolCalls
Cancellation: SIGTERM handling, agent DELETE /v1/runs/:id, cleanup
Event log: writes events.ndjson with hash chain, sequence numbers from trusted runner
Result directory: run-manifest.json, events.ndjson, submission.json, score.json (later), report.html (later), checksums.json
Duplicate run start (same case + agent + config) returns existing result (idempotent)
Timeout and cancellation terminate case cleanly, mark run as cancelled/failed

title: Tool gateway + budget enforcement (packages/tool-runtime)
description: HTTP gateway that validates calls, enforces budgets, returns fixture data
acceptance: packages/tool-runtime/src/gateway.ts: Express server on configurable port
Validates Authorization: Bearer <run-scoped-token> per run
Implements all 12 tools returning test fixtures from case inputs
Validates callId idempotency (same callId returns cached result)
Enforces per-run tool call budget from run request
Returns source IDs and citation anchors, not raw storage paths
finance.* tools use deterministic pure functions owned by tool-runtime; scorer-financial remains an independent Phase 2 implementation
Integration test: fake agent calls all tools successfully

title: Scenario state machine (packages/tool-runtime)
description: case.request_information advances deterministic YAML-defined state machine with concept-based matching
acceptance: packages/tool-runtime/src/scenario.ts: ScenarioEngine loads scenario.yaml
YAML structure: initial_state, transitions[] with from, when (tool + requested_concepts), response (status + reveal_documents), to
Concept matching: case.request_information requested_concepts[] matched against transition.when.requested_concepts
Response statuses: AVAILABLE (reveal docs), ALREADY_PROVIDED, NEEDS_CLARIFICATION
Ambiguous concept matches return NEEDS_CLARIFICATION
Hidden transitions for certification cases (not in public case)
Unit tests: multi-step scenario, duplicate request, ambiguous concept

title: CLI commands (apps/cli)
description: uwbench init-agent, validate-agent, validate-case, run, and suite commands for the unscored Phase 1 vertical slice
acceptance: apps/cli/src/index.ts: commander.js CLI entry point
uwbench init-agent: creates example agent server stub
uwbench validate-agent <url>: runs conformance testkit against URL, exits 0 on pass
uwbench validate-case <path>: runs case-schema validator, exits 0 on pass
uwbench run --case <id> --agent <url>: starts local runner, tool gateway, executes, saves result dir
uwbench run --suite <track> --agent <url>: runs all public cases in suite
Phase 1 run output is explicitly marked not_scored; the HTML report command is deferred until Phase 2 scoring exists
All commands have --help, structured output, proper exit codes
